mechanism: Foscarnet can cause nephrotoxicity and electrolyte disturbances (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia) that may impair pramipexole clearance and increase CNS toxicity risk.
action: Monitor renal function closely, maintain adequate hydration, monitor for increased pramipexole side effects (hallucinations, confusion, orthostatic hypotension), and consider dose adjustment if renal function declines.
